prompt: Gyomyo the crazy card cat holds up a big golden prize envelope with a wax seal and a ticket stub that reads nothing, eyes sparkling and tongue out, overjoyed like he won a lottery. Around him: plain brown cardboard shipping boxes with no markings at all, sealed blank trading card booster boxes, flying blank holographic cards, a small lottery drum with colorful balls, a little calendar with a circled date. Two tiny doodled flags: a red circle on white and a stars-and-stripes shape.
